messages:
Lina: Quick check — planning to cut over org-scoped feature flag for the enterprise billing UI tonight 21:00 PST. Need ops guardrails and ensure contracts-only allowlist is wired. PR: https://github.com/redwood/flags/pull/422

Omar: I can watch the canary metrics. Which orgs are in the initial slice?

Lina: Start with our alpha partners: AcmeCorp, Brightline, NorthStar (IDs posted below). Scope is per-org allowlist via Entitlements service with contract gating. Priyanka — added to the PR to surface the entitlement check?

Priyanka: Yep, added backend checks. Config lives in `configs/org_flags.json`. Snippet applied in the PR:

```json
{"org_slices": ["acme-001","bright-22","north-9"], "contract_gate": true}
```

Tyler: Product signoff: keep rollout at 5% traffic for first hour, then 20% if no regressions. Acceptance targets: p95 latency <= 350ms, error rate < 0.5%.

Noelle: Security note: OK as long as entitlement calls to the KMS-backed service are VPC-only and logs don't leak secrets. Also need audit events for flag flips.

deploy-bot: Deploy staged: flags-service v1.12 -> staging (now) -> prod (scheduled 21:00 PST). CI: all checks passed.

Omar: I'll run synthetic traffic against the flagged path every 5s and monitor RTT and 500s. If anything spikes I'll escalate to #incidents and call oncall.

Lina: Who will perform the prod flip? Need a named owner.

Priyanka: I'll flip the canary slice at 21:00. If p95 > 350ms or errors > 0.5%, Omar please kill canary and revert the flag.

Omar: ACK. Also added a safety kill switch at the payment-path level: `kill_switch_payment_v2` — tested in staging.

Tyler: Product reminder: contract gating should validate both `contract_id` and `entitlement_level == \"enterprise\"`. Otherwise trial customers with contract rows might slip through.

Lina: Good catch. Priyanka, please enforce that before prod flip.

Priyanka: Done, pushed a tiny patch to check entitlement_level in the middleware. @deploy-bot please re-run prod deploy after CI.

deploy-bot: Prod deploy re-run queued; manual flip still required by owner.

Omar: Preflight checklist: smoke tests green, canary logs routed to Datadog dashboard (https://app.datadog/example/flags_canary). I'll be watching from 20:50–22:30.

Noelle: One last compliance ask — audit logs for flips must include `org_id`, `actor_id`, `flag_version`, and be retained for 90 days. Confirm after deploy.

Priyanka: Confirmed, logs include those fields and retention policy set.

Lina: Great. If no objections we flip at 21:00. Posting a short runbook update after cutover.

Tyler: No objections. :+1:

Noelle: No objections from security.

Omar: Onpager for 21:00–22:30. Will escalate if thresholds fail.

Lina: Thanks team — thanks especially Priyanka and Omar for owning the flip/watch. I'll note this in the rollouts doc and attach the post-cutover checklist. :tada:
